simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְתוּשָׁאֵל (H4967) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מְתוּשָׁאֵל (Mᵉthûwshâʼêl) means Methusael , an antediluvian patriarch First listed occurrence: Gen 4 18.

definitions.full: H4967. Methushael מְתוּשָׁאֵל proper name, masculine descendant of Cain (Babylonian form., mutu-ša-ili 'man of God,' Len Orig. ed. 2, i. 262 f. Eng. Tr. 268 ); — Gen 4:18 (twice in verse) (J), ᵐ5 Μαθουσαλα (i.e. מְתוּשֶׁלַח ? so Di; otherwise Bu Urgesch. 125 f. )
definitions.rootNote: from 4962 and 410 , with the relative interposed; man who (is) of God;
